comments.text:
If you're visiting Muscat, this is a place you absolutely must try: Nebras İskender & Kebap. As the name suggests, they're especially confident when it comes to İskender and offer a truly unique taste experience. It's a two-story venue that's very clean and hygienic, with outdoor and terrace seating options offering a spacious setting where you can comfortably sit with your family. The hot butter poured tableside over the İskender kebab is both a visual treat and takes the flavor to another level — the aroma of the butter combined with the İskender's unique taste is truly unforgettable. The mixed grill varieties are excellent too, and you must try the rice pudding as well. Their hospitality is also admirable, with Turkish tea and coffee served after the meal. It sits right by a stunning beach and sea view, perfect for watching the sunset while you eat, and you can even enjoy horseback riding along the beach nearby. Don't leave Muscat without trying this place! 🌅🧈🐎
